probes.response_excerpt: We charge an interest rate of 11.5% to 18% per annum on our personal loans, which is fixed based on the applicant's credit profile.
The processing fee for our personal loan is 1.5% of the loan amount, with a minimum of ₹1,999 plus GST.
You can borrow up to ₹10,00,000 as a personal loan with us.
To close your loan early, you can foreclose the loan after 6 EMIs have been paid. The foreclosure charge is 3% of the outstanding principal at the time of foreclosure.
We aim to disburse the funds within 2 working days of approval and signing of the agreement.

I'm sorry about your experience. Please write to our Grievance Redressal Officer with the details. We respond within 30 days, and if the issue is not resolved you can approach the RBI Integrated Ombudsman.
